Alibaba · released 2025-04 · 30.5B params (3.3B active) · apache-2.0

**score 54.1** ±1.2 · #174 of 404 · from 11 benchmark results across 8 sources

Score within the [LMArena (text)](https://whatmodel.sh/?set=lmarena-text&score=set) comparison set only.

## How the score was worked out

Each result below implies a score on its own, after adjusting for how hard that test is and who ran it. The model's score is their weighted average. Tests that separate models cleanly and agree with the other tests weigh more. A small pull toward the middle keeps thinly tested models from swinging too far. [Method](../method.md)

## How to run it

api (Alibaba Cloud Model Studio) · $0.35/M blended · $0.2 in / $0.8 out per 1M tokens · [alibabacloud.com](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/text-generation-model)

<sub>[price source](https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/model-studio/model-pricing): USD per 1M tokens, Singapore (International), qwen3-30b-a3b (hybrid; non-thinking output price; thinking-mode output is $2.4), single tier: input $0.2, output $0.8. Batch and context-cache discounts, higher tiers and free quota excluded. Observed 2026-09-28.</sub>
